programme.desc: Author John Rees describes the role of black soldiers in the Revolutionary War. He speaks at the Bergen County Revolutionary War roundtable in Hackensack, New Jersey.

programme.title: America 250
programme.sub-title: C-SPAN's Up-Close Look at Star-Spangled Banner
programme.desc: Smithsonian National Museum of American History Curator Jennifer Jones gives C-SPAN a rare, up-close look at the original Star-Spangled Banner, the flag flown over Fort McHenry during the War of 1812.

programme.title: America 250
programme.sub-title: Tour of the U.S.S. Arlington Tribute Room
programme.desc: C-SPAN tours the Pentagon attack tribute room on the U.S.S. Arlington, one of three 9/11 memorial ships, as it makes its way to Baltimore for America's 250th birthday celebrations.

programme.title: The History of the Space Program
programme.desc: In 1957, the beeps from Sputnik, a small Russian satellite, sent the USSR & US into a space race. Teasel Muir-Harmony of the Air & Space Museum chronicles the history of space travel and how the U.S. landed on the Moon and how we're going back in 20.

programme.title: Q & A

programme.desc: Eugene Gene Kranz shares stories from his 34 years at NASA's Mission Control, beginning in 1960 with his work on Project Mercury, the first American human spaceflight program and later as flight director for NASA's Gemini and Apollo programs.

programme.title: History of the Space Shuttle Program

programme.desc: Narrated by Ricardo Montalban, this 1981 NASA film features women employed by NASA in a variety of specialized fields.

programme.title: Reel America

programme.title: C-SPAN Tours the National Air & Space Museum

programme.title: Anita McBride on First Lady Bess Truman

programme.desc: La vida cotidiana de cuatro amigos que se conocieron en la infancia, cuyas prioridades cambiaron cuando se convirtieron en adultos, se ven amenazados también por un pecado que puede destruir su amistad de años.

programme.desc: Tras su pelea con Estrella, Esteban sufre un preinfarto. María decide vender sus acciones para pagar las deudas de Héctor. Esteban descubre que Servando estaba enamorado de María.

programme.sub-title: Haciendo lo que no se debe

programme.title: Vecinos bajo la mira
